abort_policy: NO abort path: every value dispatches regardless of outcome. If TWO genuine hangs occur in one arm, that arm STOPS and is reported PARTIAL. macvdmtool is NEVER run; an unresponsive neo is reported BLOCKED.

amendments.change: gated runs 2 -> 3; the reverse-order control moves from run02 to run03
amendments.why: tools/agx-isa/wave_audit.py (the arrival gate) keys observations by `value` alone and compares the two lexicographically first run dirs; with four arms per value a reversed run02 would make a clean sweep read as 0% cross-run agreement in that tool. Both pairings are reported by this experiment's own gate.

amendments.change: half_pack oracle gains the measured source-lane RELEASE; records gain `released_lanes` (observation) and `oracle_result_match` (diagnostic, NOT a gate)
amendments.why: pilot01 refuted all seven frozen half_pack candidates for a side effect none of them expressed; the arithmetic member was correct. The release is keyed by the field under test, so the corrected oracle is MORE discriminating.

forced_labels.half_alu_fma12.ext: untested -- 64 bits wide, 2048 of 2^64 sampled; findings go to db_defects

gate_note: A capture is valid if the AUTHORED BLOB HASHES below match; repo HEAD moving because a sibling experiment lands is NOT contamination (SUBAGENT_BRIEF).

oracle.fma12_model_provenance: fitted OFFLINE from our own committed EXP-0180 raw (g17p_run02, 256/256 on each of two carriers) BEFORE this contract was frozen
oracle.halfpack_model_selected_by_pilot: hi=fp16(B+A) PLUS release (zero) of both named source half-lanes -- 80/80 on pilot01, where every release-free candidate scored 2/80. See PRE_REGISTRATION Amendment 02.
oracle.precision: binary64 evaluation, ONE rounding to binary16 RNE (fused). The two-rounding prediction is recorded per case as `alt2r`.
oracle.subnormal_and_overflow: flagged per case; a flush-to-zero result is a HARDWARE fact and is not charged against the field
oracle.unseeded_registers: predicted to read 0; verified per run by __ctl_unseeded

promotion_gate.G1: dense over encodable_range; distinct_bytes == dispatched; mutation differs from anchor ONLY inside the db.json span
promotion_gate.G2: valid observation for every value in BOTH gated runs
promotion_gate.G5: >= 2 distinct predicted post-digests AND oracle match rate >= 0.99 in BOTH runs
promotion_gate.G6: every falsifier NON-matched, and the same-dimension liveness control fired (>=6/8 oracle matches and >=2 distinct observations)
promotion_gate.G7: tokenized mnemonic and surviving-marker count equal the anchor's

runs.reuse_policy: run ids are NEVER reused or topped up; a partial capture is retained and a replacement takes a NEW id
